report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is largely healthy (error_rate 0.0014, p95 77ms, INFO 200 logs, zero dependency timeouts), yet one trace shows a 1919ms ERROR span on gateway->order. This single observation cannot establish a bounded root cause, and no order/downstream telemetry is available. Insufficient evidence to select a taxonomy candidate; hand off for downstream data.
